title: Equality of Embedded Configurations
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $S$ be a state type, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, and let $A$ be an $m$-work-tape Turing machine. Suppose $[0m[0m\iota$ embeds the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices, and let $c$ and $d$ be configurations on $m$ and $k$ work tapes, respectively, for the same input. If their states, input-head positions, and output strings agree, and for every work-tape index $i<m$ the contents and head position of tape $i$ in $c$ agree with those of tape $\iota(i)$ in $d$, then embedding $c$ into the $k$-tape configuration using $d$'s tapes and head positions for all unembedded slots, and with an empty output prefix, gives exactly $d$.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ indices
